seeker.label: I am looking for work
seeker.blurb: Build a resume, practise interviews, find employers that hire people with records.
seeker.heading: Sign in to The Refinery

participant.label: My program sent me
participant.blurb: A reentry program, workforce board, or case manager gave you a code.
participant.heading: Sign in with your program
participant.needs: Have your program's access code ready. It unlocks the full toolset at no cost to you.

org.label: I work for an organization
org.blurb: See how the people you support are doing, and step in when needed.
org.heading: Sign in to your organization
org.needs: Your organization's admin adds you to the team. If nobody has, ask them first. Signing up here creates a personal account instead.

agency.label: I am evaluating this for an agency
agency.blurb: Corrections, labor, vocational rehabilitation, or a funder.
agency.heading: Evaluating Steel Man Resumes
agency.needs: There is nothing to sign up for. The Forge runs free with no account, so the fastest way to judge this is to put a real resume through it.
agency.needsUp: The fastest way to judge this is to put a real resume through the Forge. It needs one free sign-in, the same one a job seeker uses. The free resume check needs no account at all.

chooser.footnote: Same sign-in either way. This just decides where you land. Plenty of people here hold more than one of these, and you can switch any time.

password.hint: {min}+ characters, with a letter and a number

problems.tooLong: That password is too long. Use fewer characters; some letters and symbols take more space.
problems.needsLetterAndNumber: Include at least one letter and one number.
problems.tooCommon: That password is too common. Pick something only you would know.

subheading.forge: It's free. One account for the Forge and the Refinery. You come right back to where you were.
subheading.create: Save your Forge work and continue with the full toolset.
subheading.magicLink: Sign in with a magic link
subheading.default: Continue your career work where you left off.

login.agencyNote: <forge>Open The Forge</forge> to run one end to end, or email <mail>hmu@themidnightgarden.club</mail> to talk about what running it would involve.
login.orgNote: Organization not set up yet? Email <mail>hmu@themidnightgarden.club</mail> with your organization name and program type. Free for nonprofits and community organizations.

fields.authCodeHelp: Open your authenticator app for the current code, or use a backup code.
fields.name: Your name
fields.phoneHelp: These go on the resumes you build. You can change them anytime.

forgeRun.legend: There's a resume in progress on this computer. Is it yours?
forgeRun.yes: Yes, this is my resume. Save it to my new account.
forgeRun.no: No, this isn't mine. Erase it from this computer.
forgeRun.hint: Pick yes or no above to create your account. This keeps another person's resume out of your account.

login.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, and I understand my information is processed with AI to build my resume and career tools.

switchers.newHere: New here? Create a free account
switchers.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
switchers.linkNote: We'll email a one-time link. It signs you in without changing your password.

footer.free: No credit card. No spam. Your data stays yours.
footer.notStartedUp: Haven't started yet? <link>Try The Forge</link>. It's free.
footer.notStartedOpen: Haven't started yet? <link>Try The Forge</link>. It's free, and you don't need an account.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a sign-in link to <email>{address}</email>. Click the link in the email to sign in. It expires in 24 hours.

urlErrors.Configuration: Login is temporarily unavailable. Please contact Troy.
urlErrors.AccessDenied: Access denied. Check your email and try again.
urlErrors.Verification: That link has expired. Request a new one below.
urlErrors.OAuthAccountNotLinked: You're signed in as a different account already. Sign out below, then try Google again.
urlErrors.GoogleEmailUnverified: Google has not confirmed that email address yet. Sign in with your password or an email link instead.
urlErrors.GoogleEmailMismatch: That Google account uses a different email than the account it is linked to. Sign in with your password or an email link instead.
urlErrors.SessionNotUsable: This browser is still holding an old or unfinished sign-in. Sign out below, then try Google again.

errors.signInIncomplete: Sign-in did not finish. Try again, or use an email sign-in link.
errors.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Try again.
errors.googleNotOpened: Google sign-in did not open. Try again, or use your password or an email sign-in link.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try again, or use a backup code.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.nameAndPhone: Please add your name and phone. They go on the resumes you build.
errors.agreeCreate: Please agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to create your account.
errors.agreeContinue: Please agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
errors.createdSignIn: Account created. Sign in to continue.
errors.magicLinkFailed: Could not send magic link. Try again or use a password.
errors.requestNotConfirmed: We couldn't confirm the request. Try again.

finish.title: Finish signing in
finish.signsYouInAs: This link signs you in as
finish.notYou: Not you? Don't continue. Close this page.
finish.pressButton: Press the button to finish signing in to Steel Man Resumes.
finish.incompleteBody: Part of the sign-in link is missing. Ask for a new one on the sign-in page.

reset.invalidBody: This link is missing required information. Request a new password reset email.
reset.doneBody: Your password has been updated. Sign in with your new password. If you use two-step verification, we'll ask for your code too.
reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.forEmail: This will update the password for {email}.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
